{{Quote|Any anti-Republic terrorist could pose as a refugee, and we'd have no way of verifying they're who they say they are. That could lead to dangerous situations here, on Coruscant.|First Minister Zelebitha Effhod|<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Ministry of Ingress (CMoI)''', or simply '''Ministry of Ingress''', was an [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|immigration enforcement service]] operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was responsible for monitoring immigration and emigration on Coruscant as well as protecting the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet from [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] entering as [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the CMoI answered to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the CMoI, under its [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)/Legends|First Minister]], [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]], came under public criticism for preventing immigration of refugees and deporting several [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the Republic's successor government, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the CMoI was controlled by Coruscant's military police, the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], becoming little more than the Guard's puppet. After the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government, the CMoI was dissolved.

==Overview==
The Ministry of Ingress served as the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|immigration enforcement service]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWECMoI">{{CSWECite|I|148|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress (CMoI)}}</ref> It was led by a [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)/Legends|First Minister]], who directed the operations of the CMoI and was supported by its deputy, the [[Second Minister/Legends|Second Minister]]. Both positions were [[Politics/Legends|political]] appointments that could be installed or dismissed by the head of the government. The CMoI was composed of [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] who ensured the continuation of the ministry's daily services,<ref name="TTSP" /> and [[Customs official/Legends|customs officials]] who enforced the CMoI policies and regulations.<ref name="HNN51" /> Branch offices were located throughout Coruscant's [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], including the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]].<ref name="ISWII">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The port crowding has reached dangerous levels. We can no longer assure the safety of newcomers to this world, or to the citizenry residing adjacent to the ports. In the interests of security, these new measures are needed.|First Minister Zelebitha Effhod, discussing new immigration policies|<ref name="HNN51" />}}
[[File:TannonPraji.jpg|thumb|left|180px|First Minister Tannon Praji]]
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the CMoI functioned as a ministry under the control of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Republic, [[Zelebitha Effhod]] served as First Minister of the CMoI.<ref name="HNN51" /> After the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], he appointed [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]], a member of the old [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]], to become the CMoI's Second Minister under Effhod.<ref name="TTSP" />

With the Separatist Crisis intensifying, the CMoI faced a daunting task, as billions of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] attempted to gain entry at Coruscant's various [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. New policies on required documents for entry were issued, mandating that newcomers have a [[Core Worlds Visa]], a [[Perlemian Standard Passport]], proof of planetary citizenship, and that incoming vessels have valid Coruscant [[Identichip/Legends|identi-tags]] as well as a [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] operating license.<ref name="HNN51" /> However, the new restrictions only served to increase the clogged entry lines, and security at the spaceports became perilously dangerous. Though Effhod stood indecisive in the face of the problems, Praji was able to convince her to take action. Coruscant's borders were closed indefinitely to newcomers. Meanwhile, those immigrants who were able to get through the long and arduous entry process often fell to exploitation as menial servants or worse.<ref name="TTSP" /> For its actions, CMoI received criticism from various factions including [[Merchant/Legends|free traders]], independent operators, [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] [[Bronwynn Koft]], and Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="HNN51" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Separatist Crisis exploded at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On the eve of the battle, Effhod [[Death/Legends|died]] due to [[Quannot's Syndrome]], leaving Praji to take the post of First Minister of the CMoI. The war brought increased challenges for the immigration ministry. Customs agents were charged with observing immigrants for potential [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] and Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. Facing intense pressure from the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]], Praji ordered the deportation of all members of several whole [[Species/Legends|species]] whose [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] had gone over to the Separatists, including [[Gossam/Legends|Gossams]] and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]. While the deportation of billions was a goal never fully realized, Praji became the target of several [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] and kidnapping attempts. With the subsequent [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the CMoI came under the control of Coruscant's military police, the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], and became little more than the Guard's puppet. After the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the CMoI was dissolved.<ref name="TTSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Ministry of Ingress first appeared in the "Coruscant Restricts Immigration" article of ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51]]'',<ref name="Holonet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref> which was released on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-11|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220526183032/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-10#post-6401165}}</ref> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]], and illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
